from datetime import datetime
now=datetime.now(); year=now.year
print('current year', year)

# fetch recommendations pages until we find at least one classical-looking song, while also collecting pages later
page_limit=20
page_index=0
seen=[]
classical_candidates=[]

while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    # check first 5 songs on page for genre patterns
    for item in page[:5]:
        sid=item['song_id']
        song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
        genre=song.get('genre','')
        artist_genres=[a.get('genre','') for a in song.get('artists',[])]
        classical= ('classical' in str(genre).lower()) or any('classical' in str(ag).lower() for ag in artist_genres)
        rec={'song_id':sid,'title':song['title'],'genre':genre,'artist_genres':artist_genres,'release_date':song['release_date']}
        seen.append(rec)
        if classical:
            classical_candidates.append(rec)
    page_index+=1
    if page_index>=3:
        break

print('sample genres:', [(r['song_id'], r['genre'], r['release_date'][:10]) for r in seen])
print('classical_candidates_in_samples:', classical_candidates)

from datetime import datetime
# Use existing all_recs from previous run
print('all_recs exists', 'all_recs' in globals(), 'len', len(all_recs) if 'all_recs' in globals() else None)
print('unique', len({r['song_id'] for r in all_recs}))

current_year=datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

unique_ids=sorted({r['song_id'] for r in all_recs})
filtered=[]
for sid in unique_ids:
    song=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date=song.get('release_date')
    # parse year
    rel_year=None
    if release_date:
        rel_year=datetime.fromisoformat(release_date.replace('Z','+00:00')).year if 'T' in release_date else datetime.fromisoformat(release_date).year
    genre=str(song.get('genre',''))
    artist_genres=[a.get('genre','') for a in song.get('artists',[])]
    is_classical=('classical' in genre.lower()) or any('classical' in str(ag).lower() for ag in artist_genres)
    if is_classical and rel_year==current_year:
        filtered.append({'song_id':sid,'title':song['title'],'album_title':song.get('album_title'),'release_date':release_date,'genre':genre,'artist_genres':artist_genres})

print('filtered_count', len(filtered))
print('filtered_songs', filtered)
